closing.summary: Big strengths are vitamin K, fibre, and omega 3, but the biggest weaknesses are low protein quality, low potassium, and freshness and prep can matter. It's good for immune support, digestion, and low-calorie volume because vitamin C and vitamin A help support the immune system, fibre helps digestion and keeps meals steadier, and it helps fill out a meal without many calories.
